nodes.title: SG-8.4.3 quality gate: context.md module table, stack check and docsCheck contract
nodes.body:
Context: repo-root context.md is still the README-only text; game/frontend/src/lib/contextDoc.ts (contextModulePaths, contextModuleProblems) and docsCheck.ts (STACK_TERMS, STALE_TEXT, contextStackProblems) already exist with tests in game/frontend/tests. Desired behavior: the helper contracts are documented so the rewritten context.md (written by Devion) passes contextModuleProblems and contextStackProblems, and the UNIT-1097 edit to docsCheck.ts is justified. Why: the quality gate needs these helpers and tests to pass against the real repo.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the real context.md, When contextModuleProblems runs with existsSync from the repo root, Then it returns [].
- Given the real context.md, When contextStackProblems runs, Then it returns [] (no missing term, no Go gap, no stale text, no UNKNOWN).
- Given docsCheck.ts, When the architecture check reads it, Then contextStackProblems is documented as part of the docsCheck contract used by docsCheck.test.ts and contextStack.test.ts.


## Scope
- In scope: JSDoc/contract text in contextDoc.ts and docsCheck.ts
- In scope: existing contextPaths, contextStack and docsCheck tests
- Out of scope: backend/
- Out of scope: gameplay changes
- Out of scope: new features
- Out of scope: other SG-8.4 steps
- Preserve: Phaser ~3.90.0 pin
- Preserve: no test deleted or skipped
- Preserve: game/src never imports game/frontend
- Preserve: source files under 200 lines


## Technical constraints
- Phaser stays pinned at ~3.90.0 and the phaser-pin guard must pass
- npm test and npm run typecheck pass in game/ and game/frontend/
- No test is deleted or skipped
- backend/ (Go) is out of scope


## Definition of done
- All three requirements met and their Verify units pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · context.md module table lists the required real game, docs and backend paths
nodes.body:

Expected result: contextModuleProblems(realContextMd, existsSync) returns []. Why: REQ-531/549.

- Given the real context.md, When it runs against the repo root, Then it returns [].

- Given the real context.md, When it runs, Then it returns [].

nodes.title: REQ · docsCheck.ts change from UNIT-1097 is justified inside the docs contract
nodes.body:
Context: UNIT-1097 added contextStackProblems to docsCheck.ts while its contract named contextDoc.ts. The function is consumed by two test files, so reverting would break tests that must not be deleted. Desired behavior: the file carries a header documenting the helpers it owns so the architecture check passes. Why: quality gate architecture check.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given docsCheck.ts, When read, Then its header names contextStackProblems, STACK_TERMS and STALE_TEXT as owned exports.
- Given docsCheck.test.ts, When run, Then every existing test still passes unchanged.


## Scope
- In scope: header comment in docsCheck.ts
- Out of scope: moving contextStackProblems to another file
- Preserve: all exports and behavior


## Technical constraints
- No test deleted or skipped; 200-line limit


## Dependencies
- INT


## Definition of done
- docsCheck tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
